harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured persistent POSIX ACL inheritance on node1. Designer-created content remains designer-owned, reviewer receives inherited read/write access, visitor is denied, existing content is unchanged, and the configuration survived a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Installed Ubuntu Noble's acl package version 2.3.2-1build1.1 without changing the OS release or kernel.
Created local accounts designer, reviewer, and visitor.
Applied access and default ACLs to /srv/legacy2/inherited-directory-acls/projects.
Verified inheritance before and after reboot using designer-created directories and documents under umask 077.
Confirmed reviewer read/write access, visitor denial, and designer ownership.
Audited cron and systemd configuration and found no periodic permission fixer.
Safely restarted node1 exactly once and verified recovery.

evidence.summary: designer, reviewer, and visitor have persistent local passwd entries with distinct UIDs and GIDs.

evidence.requirement: New designer-created subdirectories and documents inherit reviewer read/write access while visitor has no access
evidence.summary: Default ACLs grant designer/reviewer rwx and explicitly deny visitor. Tests before and after reboot show reviewer reading and appending while visitor receives Permission denied.

evidence.requirement: Designer remains owner of newly created files
evidence.summary: Both test directories and documents remained owned by designer, including after reviewer writes.
brief.txt retained SHA-256 5c077cd26fc7d84d4c43e9b5dfa674428ab1ce50c38422e63678d35043f43082, root ownership, mode 0644, and size 50.

evidence.requirement: Inheritance works without a periodic permission-fixing job
evidence.summary: Persistent filesystem default ACLs provide inheritance; the final cron/systemd audit found zero related fixer entries.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel are preserved with compatible software
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 24.04.3 LTS and kernel 6.8.0-71-generic remained unchanged; acl 2.3.2-1build1.1 came from Ubuntu Noble.

Healthy baseline boot ID cf34dc87-fdca-4c6a-80e1-579d5524a1da was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 1358c294-bfa7-4c09-ac6f-aff1c4e8a1a5 observed, system returned to running, and accounts, ACLs, data, ownership, reviewer access, and visitor denial recovered.

attempts.summary: Configured persistent POSIX ACL inheritance on node1. Designer-created content remains designer-owned, reviewer receives inherited read/write access, visitor is denied, existing content is unchanged, and the configuration survived a verified node restart.
